title: Gibraltar Point Lighthouse
geometryBasis: OpenStreetMap way 892934946 gives the outline of the named six-sided tower at 480 Lakeshore Avenue, matching Wikidata Q5559191 and the City’s standing lighthouse.
sectionBasis: The Toronto Public Library and 2015 conservation authority report document the hexagonal Queenston-stone structure, a heightening in 1832, and a historic overall height of 82 feet to the vane. The present gallery, iron lantern and finial proportions follow the author-released 2011 view.
limitations: Lantern glazing, sill details, exact masonry courses, and opening positions on partly hidden faces are interpreted from the 2011 photograph and documented construction.
The historic 1815 lantern, keeper’s house, surrounding woods, paths, plaques and later park improvements are outside the model.
